full_query: If the side effects of the Prozac become too much is there a wean down period I would have to go through or would I be able to stop it immediately?

shared_context.topic: stopping Prozac due to side effects

sentences: If the side effects of Prozac (fluoxetine) become too much, it is generally recommended to wean down the medication rather than stopping it abruptly
Abrupt discontinuation of Prozac can lead to withdrawal symptoms, which may include dizziness, headache, nausea, and irritability
The weaning process typically involves gradually reducing the dose over a period of time, which should be done under the guidance of a healthcare provider
The specific tapering schedule can vary depending on the individual’s current dose, duration of use, and response to the medication
